jobs.title: Data Analyst - Platform Migration
jobs.summary:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.
Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.
You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.
What you'll do
 
Profile and map
Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.
Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.
Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.
Migrate and prove
Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.
Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.
Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.
Integrations and commercial data
Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS

Leicestershire - Office Based (5 Days Per Week)
I'm hiring a Data Analyst to join the Finance Operations team of one of the UK's largest businesses, supporting a portfolio of major brands operating on a market-leading eCommerce and fulfilment platform.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytical problem-solver who enjoys investigating operational issues, working with large datasets, and helping stakeholders make better decisions through data.
The role You'll sit within the team responsible for supporting partner brands operating on a large-scale platform.
These brands rely on the business for:
eCommerce technology
Warehousing
Logistics
Stock management
Financial operations
Your role will focus on helping operational teams understand performance, identify issues, and improve outcomes through data.
This isn't a project-heavy role with months-long delivery cycles.

We provide 86,000 homes and invest in communities across London, the South East, South West and East of England, as well as aiming to create thousands of new affordable homes every year.

Act as a key point of contact for data subjects, managing and responding to Data Subject Rights Requests (DSRs).

Help investigate and escalate data protection incidents and potential breaches.
Maintain data protection records, registers, policies, and compliance documentation.
Support the delivery of privacy training, communications, and awareness initiatives across the business.
Work collaboratively with teams across SNG to embed a strong culture of data protection and privacy.
What we're looking for
Experience working in a Data Protection, Privacy, Compliance, Governance, or similar environment.
Good understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, and data subject rights.
Strong analytical, organisational, and administrative skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Pro.
